families.name: Bluetooth keyboard or mouse
families.recovery: Pair in OS Bluetooth settings. No extra receiver.

families.name: Logitech Unifying
families.recovery: Genuine Unifying receiver (C-U0007 / C-U0008) + official pairing software.

families.name: Logitech Bolt
families.recovery: Genuine Bolt receiver + Logi Options+. Unifying sticks will not work.

families.name: Microsoft 2.4 GHz desktop
families.recovery: Official replacement receiver for the exact model printed under the unit.

families.name: No-name 2.4 GHz nano set
families.recovery: Factory-paired to one stick. Empty slot is parts, not a software problem.

families.name: Infrared wireless
families.recovery: Needs the original IR brick. Not a 2.4 GHz dongle.

families.name: Wired USB mis-sorted
families.recovery: Plug in and list if it types.
